race.comment: Great little 3yo sprint with form converging from everywhere. FOVEA (13) looked slick winning on debut at Kembla Grange then went way too fast in front over 1100m, tiring late to finish second behind a handy one. Back to 1000m suits much better, she'll give a sight. Very wary of OLE GO (3) who comes over from South Australia for the Hickmott yard who can set one for Flemington. Won well first up as favourite and fancy he'll improve sharply into this with McDonald booked. PEYTON (4) comes through the best race, working home well for fifth in the G2 Roman Consul behind Satono Glow last start. Back to 1000m maybe a niggle but he rates well off that. PARCAE (12) has done nothing wrong in two wins to date and should give a sight again.
